payload.summary: Ingestion: a job whose last attempt ends uncertain stays processing forever (follow-up to PR 3546)
payload.detail: An uncertain outcome (SQLSTATE 40003, connection loss, worker crash) on a job's final attempt cancels without fail_or_retry_ingestion_job, and claim_ingestion_jobs skips expired leases at max_attempts, so the job never leaves processing. Owner chose a separate fenced recovery migration for expired exhausted leases. Database change, needs the owner's explicit permission.
